case: MySQL/MariaDB TIME fractional precision rounding and truncation matrix
contract: Each case inserts 12:34:56.789956 into TIME(0), TIME(1), TIME(2), TIME(3), TIME(4), TIME(5), and TIME(6), using both bound parameters and generated SQL literals.
MySQL default SQL mode rounds at each declared precision; TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL truncates.
MariaDB default SQL mode truncates at each declared precision; TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL rounds.
Each stored value is checked as Value::Time, CAST(value AS CHAR), and MICROSECOND(value), against a local precision-based arithmetic oracle.

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration time_fractional_precision_matrix -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings
